text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: ONE SEED PER LEVEL. The rank change is ×1.854 under R3 and ×1.940 under the canonical statistic — both CLEAR this block's own step-400 floors of ×1.449 and ×1.570,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: the grey bands in (a) and (b). §4.1's ×3.295 is a DIFFERENT BLOCK and a different arm and is not drawn here.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: THE MONOTONICITY AND THE CO-MEASURED COSINE CARRY THIS RESULT, NOT THE MAGNITUDE OF THE RANK CHANGE, and no sentence about it may be quoted as though they did — least of all the pass.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: F9. Draft section 4.9a. Raising the covariance-decorrelation weight raises effective rank monotonically across three levels while the RNA-view patient-to-patient mutual cosine - a direct

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: measurement of the condition rank exists to detect - rises monotonically WITH it, co-measured on the identical runs and printed on the same log lines. At 0.8696 the RNA-view states of

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: different patients are nearly the same vector, and rank moves the wrong way as that worsens. This is a stronger dissociation than draft section 4.9's instances for two reasons about the

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: SHAPE of the evidence rather than its size: it is monotone across three levels rather than a single contrast, and the contradicting quantity is co-measured rather than inferred from a

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: downstream readout in another table. The floor drawn in (a) and (b) is THIS BLOCK'S OWN, per statistic, at the reading step these runs are quoted at: five same-seed repeats of each of two

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: arms on the fixed held-out probe at step 400 give 1.4489x under R3 and 1.5702x under canonical R1, and the sweep clears both. Draft section 4.1's 3.295x is canonical R1 on the

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: residualised EXPORTED wsi_biology block of a DIFFERENT ARM at 40 epochs; it never licensed this comparison and is deliberately not drawn - an earlier version of this figure drew it and

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: printed BOTH INSIDE, which is the block mismatch draft section 4.1a exists to catch. Clearing is not what the figure claims: at one seed per level a magnitude that clears an n = 5 floor

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: is not evidence of a dose-response, and the floor itself is n = 5 per arm at one seed on one stack. Draft section 4.1a rows 54-55. It also carries a correction: "feature_decorrelation is

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: defective" was CONDITIONAL ON A QUERY-WRITTEN QUEUE. Without a momentum key encoder the same term aggravated the collapse (1.59 against 2.17 at step 250, draft section 5.1 instance 3);

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: with one it raises rank. Every claim this project makes about that term needs "in the absence of a momentum key encoder" attached. Statistic and block are named on every axis, and R3 and

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: the canonical statistic occupy separate panels because binding constraint 1 forbids two rank statistics on one axis.
